##### Project general facts

Al Ameera Village is a thoughtfully planned residential development, which offers a collection of studio, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments at an accessible entry point with 100% freehold ownership. The architecture reflects a traditional-inspired design language, enhanced with modern detailing and clean, dynamic features. The project is positioned within the peaceful suburb of Al Yasmeen, Ajman, ensuring a calm residential atmosphere while maintaining excellent connectivity to Dubai, Sharjah, and Ras Al Khaimah.

The development offers a well-rounded lifestyle supported by a range of essential and leisure-oriented amenities. Residents benefit from a diverse commercial hub within the community, providing everyday convenience just steps away from home. The overall environment is designed to combine comfort and functionality, making it suitable for both families and individuals seeking a balanced lifestyle with easy access to urban centres and key destinations across the UAE.

Inside, the residences feature premium-quality finishes with a focus on comfort and practicality. Interiors are designed with spacious layouts that maximise natural light and living efficiency, while elegant detailing enhances the overall aesthetic. Kitchens are beautifully designed and equipped as gourmet spaces, complemented by well-appointed bathrooms that promote relaxation. The units are delivered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalise their homes while enjoying a refined foundation of built-in quality and craftsmanship.

##### Location description and benefits

Ajman the smallest yet most diverse of all emirates in UAE. Located strategically in the middle of the emirates, it borders Sharjah and only 10 km away from Dubai. Hence, it provides an easy commute to other emirates. The perennial sunshine of its golden shores sitting alongside the serene beaches is a heaven away from the hassles of life. Its untouched landscapes, misty mangroves, Age-old traditions and authentic culture, along with the contemporary infrastructure make it a unique place to experience.

Ajman’s diversity and sustainable development attracts a large number of investors who are keen to tap into its lucrative business opportunities. The opening of Ajman’s free zone and visa extensions for investors is injecting more liquidity into the local economy and is boosting the underlying confidence of foreign investors. New laws by the UAE government to grant citizenship to expatriates and easing the rules to provide a conducive atmosphere for them, Ajman is rapidly growing as a major hub for prospective investors to live and work in.

The overall vibe of this emirate, due to the rate of new developments and years’ old traditions, is so soothing that it has an edge over other emirates to cater to anyone seeking comfort, luxury, and tranquility at the same time.
